width.description: Figure width in CSS pixels. Ignored when `autosize` fills the container.

height.description: Figure height in CSS pixels. Ignored when `autosize` fills the container.

autosize.description: Size the figure to its container on first render (and on resize with `config.responsive`).

pad.description: Padding between the plot area and the axis lines, in CSS pixels.

autoexpand.description: Let components (legend, colorbars, automargin axes) grow the margins.

gutter.description: Holochart extension: space (CSS px) kept between the figure edge and content that grows a margin (automargin tick labels and axis titles, legends, colorbars), so it never touches the edge. 0 (Plotly) lets that content reach the edge.

paper_bgcolor.description: Background color of the whole figure.

plot_bgcolor.description: Background color of the plot area between the axes.

font.description: Global font. Every text element inherits unset font fields from here.

family.description: CSS font-family list used by every text element unless overridden.

size.description: Base font size in CSS pixels.

variant.description: Capitals variant (CSS `font-variant-caps`). The SDF text renderer approximates small and petite caps with uppercase letters at a reduced size.

textcase.description: Letter case transform: `upper`, `lower`, `word caps` (first letter of each word), or `normal`.

lineposition.description: Text decoration: `under`, `over` and/or `through` joined with `+` (e.g. `under+over`), or `none`.

shadow.description: CSS `text-shadow` behind the text (`2px 2px 3px black`; only the first shadow is drawn), `none`, or `auto` for a thin halo in the contrast color of the text.

colorway.description: Default trace colors, cycled by trace index.

template.description: Template: a registered name (`'dark'`), a `+`-composition (`'dark+presentation'`) or an object `{ layout, data }`. `null` disables the default template.

font.description: Title font. Defaults to `layout.font` with 1.4× size.

family.description: CSS font-family list. The renderer uses the first family it can load and falls back through the list.

weight.description: Font weight: a CSS numeric weight (1–1000), `normal` or `bold`.

variant.description: Capitals variant (CSS `font-variant-caps`). The SDF text renderer approximates small and petite caps with uppercase letters at a reduced size.

textcase.description: Letter case transform: `upper`, `lower`, `word caps` (first letter of each word), or `normal`.

lineposition.description: Text decoration: `under`, `over` and/or `through` joined with `+` (e.g. `under+over`), or `none`.

shadow.description: CSS `text-shadow` behind the text (`2px 2px 3px black`; only the first shadow is drawn), `none`, or `auto` for a thin halo in the contrast color of the text.

y.description: Vertical position in `yref` coordinates. `auto` places it in the top margin.

xref.description: `container` spans the whole figure; `paper` spans the plot area.

yref.description: `container` spans the whole figure; `paper` spans the plot area.

xanchor.description: Horizontal alignment of the title box relative to `x`.

yanchor.description: Vertical alignment of the title box relative to `y`.

showlegend.description: Show the legend. Defaults to `true` when more than one trace has a legend entry.

uniformtext.description: Uniform text sizing for bar and pie labels (E4.6).

mode.description: Uniform size for the text inside bars and pie slices, per trace type (E4.6): labels are drawn at the smallest fitted size; `hide` drops labels that would be smaller than `minsize`, `show` draws them at the uniform size. `false` lets every label scale on its own.

minsize.description: Minimum text size in px for `uniformtext.mode`. Also raises trace fonts smaller than it.

hovermode.description: How hover picks points: nearest point, all points at the same x/y, or unified labels.

dragmode.description: What dragging on the plot area does: zoom, pan, box or lasso select, or draw a new shape (`draw*`, styled by `newshape`).

ordering.description: Whether layout or trace changes animate first.

uirevision.description: While unchanged across updates, user interaction state (zoom, legend toggles, selections) is preserved.

datarevision.description: Change this to force data arrays to be re-read when they are mutated in place.

meta.description: Arbitrary user data, available in text templates as `%{meta}`.

grid.description: A grid of subplots (Plotly `layout.grid`). Cartesian axes placed in the grid get their `domain`, `anchor`, `side` and `position` defaults from their cell; domain traces (pie, …) are placed with `domain.row` / `domain.column`. Values given on an axis or a trace always win.

rows.description: Number of rows. Defaults to the length of `subplots` or `yaxes`. A grid needs more than one cell (`rows * columns > 1`); otherwise it is ignored.

roworder.description: Whether row 0 (of `subplots`, `yaxes` and trace `domain.row`) is the top row or the bottom row.

columns.description: Number of columns. Defaults to the length of `subplots[0]` or `xaxes`.

subplots.description: The cartesian subplot of each cell, as a 2D array `[row][column]` of ids like `'xy'` or `'x2y3'`, or `''` for an empty cell. All cells of a column must share one x axis and all cells of a row one y axis; a subplot that breaks this, or that no trace or axis creates, leaves its cell empty. Takes precedence over `xaxes`/`yaxes`. With `pattern: 'independent'` and no arrays, it defaults to `'xy'`, `'x2y2'`, … in row-major order.

xaxes.description: The x axis of each column (`'x'`, `'x2'`, …, or `''` for none), used when there is no `subplots` array. Defaults to `'x'`, `'x2'`, … for `pattern: 'coupled'`.

yaxes.description: The y axis of each row (`'y'`, `'y2'`, …, or `''` for none), used when there is no `subplots` array. Defaults to `'y'`, `'y2'`, … for `pattern: 'coupled'`.

pattern.description: Default cell contents when neither `subplots` nor `xaxes`/`yaxes` is given: `coupled` shares one x axis per column and one y axis per row (`xaxes: ['x', 'x2', …]`, `yaxes: ['y', 'y2', …]`); `independent` gives every cell its own pair (`'xy'`, `'x2y2'`, … in row-major order).

xgap.description: Horizontal space between columns, as a fraction of a column width. Defaults to 0.2 for a grid of independent subplots (`subplots` or `pattern: independent`), 0.1 otherwise.

ygap.description: Vertical space between rows, as a fraction of a row height. Defaults to 0.3 for a grid of independent subplots (`subplots` or `pattern: independent`), 0.1 otherwise.

domain.description: The part of the plot area the grid fills.

x.description: Horizontal extent `[start, end]` of the whole grid, as fractions of the plot area. An empty or reversed extent falls back to `[0, 1]`.

y.description: Vertical extent `[start, end]` of the whole grid, as fractions of the plot area (from the bottom). An empty or reversed extent falls back to `[0, 1]`.

xside.description: Where the x axes are drawn by default: `bottom plot` / `top plot` against the bottom-most / top-most subplot of their column; `bottom` / `top` at the bottom / top edge of the grid (`anchor: 'free'`), even when that cell is empty.

yside.description: Where the y axes are drawn by default: `left plot` / `right plot` against the left-most / right-most subplot of their row; `left` / `right` at the left / right edge of the grid (`anchor: 'free'`), even when that cell is empty.

xaxis.description: A x axis. `xaxis2`, `xaxis3`, … declare further x axes, referenced from traces as `'x2'`, `'x3'`, ….

visible.description: Draw the axis (line, ticks, labels, grid and title). A hidden axis still maps data to pixels.

color.description: Base color of the axis: the default for `linecolor`, `tickcolor`, `zerolinecolor`, `dividercolor` and (when changed) the tick-label and title font colors.

type.description: Axis type. `'-'` detects the type from the data of the first trace on this axis (Plotly's rules: mostly dates → `date`; more than twice as many distinct strings as numbers → `category`; two-level `[[groups], [items]]` arrays → `multicategory`; otherwise `linear`).

autotypenumbers.description: How type detection treats numeric strings: `convert types` counts `'12'` as a number; `strict` counts only real numbers, so numeric strings make a `category` axis.

autorange.description: Whether the range is computed from the data. `reversed` autoranges with the axis flipped. `min`/`max` autorange only that end and take the other from `range` (`min reversed`/`max reversed` also flip the axis). Defaults to `false` when a full `range` is given, and to `min`/`max` when one end of `range` is `null`.

autorangeoptions.description: Constraints applied to the computed autorange.

minallowed.description: The autoranged minimum is exactly this value (data units).

maxallowed.description: The autoranged maximum is exactly this value (data units).

clipmin.description: The autoranged minimum is at least this value (data units).

clipmax.description: The autoranged maximum is at most this value (data units).

include.description: Value(s) the autorange must include (data units).

rangemode.description: Linear axes only. `tozero` extends the autorange to include 0; `nonnegative` keeps it ≥ 0.

fixedrange.description: Disables zoom and pan on this axis (drag, scroll, and modebar zoom leave its range alone).

range.description: Visible range `[start, end]` in data units (numbers, dates or category names; exponents on log axes, as in Plotly). Setting it turns `autorange` off; `null` for one end autoranges that end only.

minallowed.description: Lowest value zoom and pan may reach, in range units (like `range`: exponents on log axes). Also caps the autorange.

maxallowed.description: Highest value zoom and pan may reach, in range units (like `range`: exponents on log axes). Also caps the autorange.

domain.description: Fraction of the plot area `[start, end]` this axis spans.

anchor.description: The y axis this axis is drawn against, or `free`. Defaults to the y axis of the first subplot using this axis.

side.description: Which side of the plot area the axis is drawn on.

overlaying.description: Draw this axis over another x axis (`'x'`, `'x2'`, …), sharing its `domain` (this axis' own `domain` is ignored), e.g. a secondary y axis with `side: 'right'`. Unset (or `free`) by default. The target must exist and must not overlay another axis itself; otherwise this is ignored. Templates cannot set it, since it names specific axes. Zoom and pan do not yet move overlaid axes together (plan E3.9).

position.description: Position of the axis in paper coordinates (0–1 across the y direction). Only used when `anchor` is `free`.

layer.description: Draw the axis line, ticks and labels above or below the traces. Grid lines are always below.

automargin.description: Grow the figure margins so tick labels and the title fit (E4.2). `true` allows every direction; flags restrict it.

tickmode.description: `auto` picks up to `nticks` round ticks; `linear` places ticks from `tick0` every `dtick`; `array` uses `tickvals`/`ticktext`; `sync` aligns with the overlaid axis (reserved; behaves as `auto`). Defaults to `array` when `tickvals` is set, `linear` when `dtick` is set, else `auto`.

nticks.description: Maximum number of ticks for `tickmode: auto` (the actual number may be lower so steps stay round). 0 picks it from the axis length.

tick0.description: Position of one tick for `tickmode: linear` (data units; a date on date axes, an exponent on log axes unless `dtick` is `L<f>`). Defaults to 0, or 2000-01-01 on date axes.

dtick.description: Tick step. Linear axes: a positive number. Log axes: an integer `n` (a tick every `n` decades), `L<f>` (linear steps of `f` in data units, e.g. `L0.5`), `D1` (every digit) or `D2` (1, 2 and 5). Date axes: milliseconds, or `M<n>` for `n` months (`M12` for years).

ticktext.description: Tick labels for `tickvals`. Missing entries are formatted as usual.

family.description: CSS font-family list. The renderer uses the first family it can load and falls back through the list.

weight.description: Font weight: a CSS numeric weight (1–1000), `normal` or `bold`.

variant.description: Capitals variant (CSS `font-variant-caps`). The SDF text renderer approximates small and petite caps with uppercase letters at a reduced size.

textcase.description: Letter case transform: `upper`, `lower`, `word caps` (first letter of each word), or `normal`.

lineposition.description: Text decoration: `under`, `over` and/or `through` joined with `+` (e.g. `under+over`), or `none`.

shadow.description: CSS `text-shadow` behind the text (`2px 2px 3px black`; only the first shadow is drawn), `none`, or `auto` for a thin halo in the contrast color of the text.

tickangle.description: Tick-label rotation in degrees. `auto` rotates x-axis labels by the first `autotickangles` entry that avoids overlap.

autotickangles.description: Candidate angles, in order of preference, for `tickangle: auto`.

tickformat.description: Tick-label format: a [d3-format](https://github.com/d3/d3-format) specifier for numbers (`.2f`, `~s`, `$,`) or a [d3-time-format](https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format) specifier for dates (`%b %Y`), plus `%{n}f` for `n` digits of fractional seconds and `%h` for the half year. Empty picks a format automatically.

tickformatstops.description: Zoom-dependent tick formats: the first enabled stop whose `dtickrange` contains the current tick step replaces `tickformat`.

visible.description: Set to `false` (by the template machinery) when `templateitemname` names no template stop; hidden stops are ignored like disabled ones.

dtickrange.description: Range `[min, max]` of the tick step (`dtick`) this format applies to; `null` for an open end. Date steps are in ms or `M<n>`.

value.description: The `tickformat` to use while the tick step is inside `dtickrange`.

name.description: Name of this tickformatstop, used to reference it from a template via `templateitemname`.

templateitemname.description: Name of a template tickformatstop to inherit from. If no template item matches, this tickformatstop is hidden (`visible: false`).

hoverformat.description: Format of this axis’ values in hover labels (same syntax as `tickformat`). Empty uses the tick format with extra precision.

exponentformat.description: How large and small numbers are written: `none` (1000000), `e` (1e+6), `E` (1E+6), `power` (1×10⁶), `SI` (1M), `B` (like SI but 1B for 10⁹).

showexponent.description: Which tick labels show the exponent.

minexponent.description: Smallest decimal exponent written in exponent form (`SI`/`B` and exponent formats); smaller magnitudes are written out in full.

separatethousands.description: Always separate thousands (1,000). By default only numbers with 5 or more integer digits are separated.

ticklabelmode.description: Date axes: `instant` labels the tick instant; `period` centers each label in the period that starts at its tick (e.g. month names between month ticks).

ticklabelposition.description: Tick labels outside or inside the plot area, optionally shifted to one side of the tick (`top`/`bottom` for y axes, `left`/`right` for x axes).

ticklabeloverflow.description: What to do with labels that overflow: keep them, or hide those past the figure or the axis domain. Defaults to `hide past div` for outside labels and `hide past domain` for inside labels.

ticklabelstep.description: Label every n-th tick only (`tickmode` `auto` and `linear`).

minorloglabels.description: Log axes whose automatic ticks fall between powers of ten (2, 5 or every digit): `small digits` labels them with a small digit (2, 5), `complete` with the full value in the tick font, with `tickprefix`/`ticksuffix` (20, 50, 200), `none` leaves them unlabelled.

ticklabelshift.description: Shift of tick labels along the axis, in px.

ticklabelstandoff.description: Extra distance between tick labels and ticks, in px.

categoryorder.description: Order of categories: as they first appear in the traces (`trace`), alphabetical/numerical (`category ascending|descending`), `categoryarray` first (`array`), or by an aggregate of the trace values per category (`total`, `min`, `max`, `sum`, `mean`, `median`). Defaults to `array` when `categoryarray` is set, else `trace`.

categoryarray.description: Category order for `categoryorder: array`. Categories not listed follow in trace order.

showdividers.description: Multicategory axes: draw divider lines between groups.

mirror.description: Repeat the axis line on the opposite side of the plot area: `true` (line), `ticks` (line and ticks); `all`/`allticks` do the same on every subplot sharing this axis.

ticks.description: Draw tick marks outside or inside the plot area, or not at all (`''`).

showgrid.description: Draw grid lines at each tick.

griddash.description: Dash style: `solid`, `dot`, `dash`, `longdash`, `dashdot`, `longdashdot`, or a CSS-like list of dash lengths in px (`5px,10px,2px,2px`).

zeroline.description: Draw a line at 0 (linear axes whose range contains 0).

minor.description: Minor ticks and grid lines between the major ticks.

tickmode.description: As the major `tickmode`. Defaults to `array` when `minor.tickvals` is set, `linear` when `minor.dtick` is set, else `auto`.

nticks.description: Maximum number of minor ticks per major interval for `tickmode: auto` (0 picks it from the axis length).

tick0.description: As the major `tick0`. Defaults to the major `tick0`.

dtick.description: Minor tick step. Tick step. Linear axes: a positive number. Log axes: an integer `n` (a tick every `n` decades), `L<f>` (linear steps of `f` in data units, e.g. `L0.5`), `D1` (every digit) or `D2` (1, 2 and 5). Date axes: milliseconds, or `M<n>` for `n` months (`M12` for years).

ticks.description: Draw minor tick marks outside or inside the plot area, or not at all.

ticklen.description: Minor tick length in px. Defaults to 60% of `ticklen`.

tickwidth.description: Minor tick width in px. Defaults to `tickwidth`.

gridcolor.description: Minor grid color. Defaults to `gridcolor` blended halfway to the plot background.

gridwidth.description: Minor grid width in px. Defaults to `gridwidth`.

griddash.description: Minor grid dash style. Defaults to `griddash`. Dash style: `solid`, `dot`, `dash`, `longdash`, `dashdot`, `longdashdot`, or a CSS-like list of dash lengths in px (`5px,10px,2px,2px`).

text.description: Axis title text (supports rich-text tags, E2.10).

font.description: Axis title font. Defaults to `layout.font` with 1.2× size.

standoff.description: Distance in px between the tick labels and the title. By default it follows the tick labels automatically.

minor.description: Minor ticks and grid lines between the major ticks.

tickmode.description: As the major `tickmode`. Defaults to `array` when `minor.tickvals` is set, `linear` when `minor.dtick` is set, else `auto`.

nticks.description: Maximum number of minor ticks per major interval for `tickmode: auto` (0 picks it from the axis length).

tick0.description: As the major `tick0`. Defaults to the major `tick0`.

dtick.description: Minor tick step. Tick step. Linear axes: a positive number. Log axes: an integer `n` (a tick every `n` decades), `L<f>` (linear steps of `f` in data units, e.g. `L0.5`), `D1` (every digit) or `D2` (1, 2 and 5). Date axes: milliseconds, or `M<n>` for `n` months (`M12` for years).

ticks.description: Draw minor tick marks outside or inside the plot area, or not at all.

ticklen.description: Minor tick length in px. Defaults to 60% of `ticklen`.

tickwidth.description: Minor tick width in px. Defaults to `tickwidth`.

gridcolor.description: Minor grid color. Defaults to `gridcolor` blended halfway to the plot background.

gridwidth.description: Minor grid width in px. Defaults to `gridwidth`.

griddash.description: Minor grid dash style. Defaults to `griddash`. Dash style: `solid`, `dot`, `dash`, `longdash`, `dashdot`, `longdashdot`, or a CSS-like list of dash lengths in px (`5px,10px,2px,2px`).

text.description: Axis title text (supports rich-text tags, E2.10).

font.description: Axis title font. Defaults to `layout.font` with 1.2× size.

family.description: CSS font-family list. The renderer uses the first family it can load and falls back through the list.

weight.description: Font weight: a CSS numeric weight (1–1000), `normal` or `bold`.

variant.description: Capitals variant (CSS `font-variant-caps`). The SDF text renderer approximates small and petite caps with uppercase letters at a reduced size.

textcase.description: Letter case transform: `upper`, `lower`, `word caps` (first letter of each word), or `normal`.

lineposition.description: Text decoration: `under`, `over` and/or `through` joined with `+` (e.g. `under+over`), or `none`.

shadow.description: CSS `text-shadow` behind the text (`2px 2px 3px black`; only the first shadow is drawn), `none`, or `auto` for a thin halo in the contrast color of the text.

standoff.description: Distance in px between the tick labels and the title. By default it follows the tick labels automatically.

responsive.description: Resize the chart when its container or the window resizes.

staticPlot.description: Render once with no interactivity (no hover, zoom or modebar).

displayModeBar.description: Show the modebar always (`true`), never (`false`) or on hover.

modeBarButtonsToRemove.description: Names of default modebar buttons to remove.

modeBarButtonsToAdd.description: Extra modebar buttons: names of built-in buttons or custom button objects.

scrollZoom.description: Which subplot kinds zoom on mouse wheel. `true`/`false` enable/disable all of them.

doubleClick.description: What double-clicking the plot area does.

doubleClickDelay.description: Maximum delay between two clicks of a double-click, in milliseconds.

editable.description: Make titles, legend, annotations and shapes editable in place (E6.7).

legendText.description: Edit trace names in the legend.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for number/date formatting and UI strings.

ariaLabel.description: The chart's accessible name (`aria-label`), read by screen readers. Empty: `layout.meta.description` when set, else the figure title followed by an automatic summary ("Line chart with 3 traces"). Holochart only (plan E17.1).

toImageButtonOptions.description: Options for the modebar "download image" button.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels (defaults to the chart).

height.description: Height in CSS pixels (defaults to the chart).

antialias.description: Request an antialiased WebGL context (fixed at context creation).

worker.description: Run the calc stage in a Web Worker (ADR-011). `auto` switches on above a data-size threshold.

hoverRenderer.description: How hover labels render. Only `dom` (positioned HTML over the canvas) exists in M1; a WebGL label renderer is planned (E5.7).

renderHover.description: Custom hover label: `(points) => HTMLElement | null`. Return `null`/`undefined` to use the built-in label. Not serializable (ADR-012).

textRenderer.description: Render text as WebGL SDF glyphs or as a DOM overlay (ADR-005).

strict.description: Throw on the first validation error instead of warning (once per attribute path).

debug.description: Log update plans and pipeline timings to the console.
